command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj A64-P2-add-imm12-lsl12.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input: `add x0, x1, #0x1, lsl #12` / `#0x123` / `add x2, x3, #0xfff, lsl #12` / `add x0, x1, #0x0, lsl #12`, which give field content 0, 291, 4095 and 0 with `sh` = 1. The `lsl #12` spelling makes `llvm-mc` treat the operand as `imm12` content; the same literals without the shift would be `aarch64:add/x64-imm12-lsl0`. Measured in `EXP-0013` §3.
source: Arm MRS ADD_64_addsub_imm, sh at 22+1, imm12 at 10+12
